findings.description: Existing unconfigured gateway adapter retained unchanged. Do not implement gateway; verify only existing checkout/settlement behavior with local/synthetic providers.
Checkout status polling stopped after one network error; now retries and ignores late responses across order navigation.
Signed-in header overflowed on Uzbek 320px; narrow screens retain all controls on a second row. Report table has its own keyboard-accessible horizontal region.
Order history silently stopped at 100 rows; added stable paginated history endpoint and UI. Disposable DB regression retrieves >100 without missing/duplicate records.
A delayed reply/status update could reopen a previously selected support thread in HR/admin. Thread generation now guards post-action refreshes.
Four old HR component tests and LinkedIn visual harness were stale. Updated explicit dependencies/fixture entitlement and automatic preview expectations; HR 13/13 and LinkedIn visual 72 cases pass.
UTC daily analytics labels used browser local timezone and shifted one day in negative UTC offsets. Date labels now format explicitly in UTC; real-browser America/Los_Angeles regression added.

Timestamp-only offset batches could omit/repeat equal-createdAt jobs during full index rebuild, causing keyword fallback and intermittent zero results for typo queries. Changed to immutable unique-ID keyset batches; two complete rebuilds assert all 1105 fixtures exactly once.

A valid unbroken long ticket subject stretched admin support to 2548px at 320/390px. Scoped wrapping now preserves full subject/message text in HR/admin without page overflow; real UI regression uses a >130-character word and admin mobile widths.

All public pricing CTAs lost the selected package during registration/onboarding. Validated return URLs and a server-side preferredPackage now retain the intent through language/refresh/logout/login, and show it for explicit per-job confirmation. Signed-in recruiters return directly to their workspace. A preference never creates or pays an order.
Delayed package loads or order creation could render/redirect after changing job context. Active-context guards prevent old responses and duplicate submission; six focused regressions pass.
